title: Hydragen layer manifest metadata (draft)
description: Initial metadata requirements for layer.json, the JSON manifest at the root of every layer's repository. Name is required; author and description are optional. This schema validates contents, not filename or location, and does not yet validate dependency references or other layer behaviour.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL or relative path used by an editor or validator.

name.description: The layer's name. Naming syntax and uniqueness rules remain undecided.

author.description: Optional person or organisation credited with authoring the layer. When supplied, this must be a non-blank string. This is descriptive metadata, not a verified identity.

description.description: Optional short explanation of what the layer provides or is used for. When supplied, this must be a non-blank string.
